description: No documentation of counseling regarding lithium toxicity risk, hydration status, or renal function monitoring during hospitalization and at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Lithium and lamotrigine were continued; no serum drug levels were drawn during hospitalization.
evidence_in_summary: Despite recommendation, documentation is lacking on counseling regarding lithium toxicity risk, especially in cases of hydration or renal compromise.
suggested_correction: Include explicit counseling on lithium toxicity risks, proper hydration, renal function monitoring, and ordering lithium serum levels during hospitalization and discharge instructions.

description: Follow-up appointment with neurology and psychiatry scheduled only in 6 months; no urgent or sooner follow-up arranged despite recent increased migraine frequency and fatigue.
evidence_in_history: Plan from office visit 1 suggested follow-up in 3 months or sooner if worsening symptoms; recent migraine frequency increased and fatigue present.
evidence_in_summary: Follow-up appointment with neurology and psychiatry scheduled in 6 months (*urgent or sooner follow-up not arranged despite recent increase in migraine frequency and fatigue*).
suggested_correction: Arrange earlier follow-up appointments within 3 months or sooner if symptoms worsen, documented in discharge instructions.

description: No lab orders included or communicated in discharge paperwork for repeat CBC and ferritin to monitor anemia status.
evidence_in_history: Plan includes monitoring CBC and ferritin in 3 months to confirm resolution of anemia.
evidence_in_summary: Repeat CBC and ferritin labs recommended in 3 months (*no lab orders included or communicated in discharge paperwork*).
suggested_correction: Include explicit lab orders for CBC and serum ferritin for follow-up monitoring and communicate to patient and care providers.

description: No assessment documented for menstrual or other bleeding causes contributing to iron deficiency anemia; no referral made to hematology or gastroenterology for anemia workup.
evidence_in_history: Iron deficiency anemia diagnosed; underlying cause not fully evaluated in office visits.
evidence_in_summary: No information noted regarding assessment for menstrual or other bleeding contributing to iron deficiency. No referral to hematology or gastroenterology conducted to investigate underlying cause of anemia.
suggested_correction: Conduct and document assessment for bleeding sources (gynecological or GI) and arrange appropriate specialist referrals for anemia etiology evaluation.

description: No documentation of suicide risk assessment or mental health crisis safety plan despite bipolar disorder diagnosis with symptoms of fatigue and irritability.
evidence_in_history: Fatigue and mild irritability reported; bipolar disorder present with no mention of suicide risk assessment.
evidence_in_summary: Suicide risk assessment was not documented despite bipolar diagnosis with fatigue and irritability. No safety plan or psychosocial follow-up arranged.
suggested_correction: Perform and document suicide risk assessment, create safety plan, and arrange appropriate psychosocial follow-up before discharge.

description: No mention or documentation of folic acid or vitamin D supplementation for anemia or mood disorder support.
evidence_in_history: No folic acid or vitamin D supplementation mentioned in medication list or office visits for anemia/mood support.
evidence_in_summary: *No new medications added on discharge. Documentation missing regarding folic acid or vitamin D supplementation for anemia or mood support.*
suggested_correction: Consider evaluation for and document folic acid and vitamin D supplementation as supportive therapy; include rationale if not indicated.

description: Medication reconciliation missing NSAIDs or alternative migraine adjuncts that might be relevant due to migraine management.
evidence_in_history: No NSAIDs or other non-specified migraine adjunct medications documented in history or plan.
evidence_in_summary: Medication reconciliation does not list NSAIDs or other common migraine adjuncts that may be relevant.
suggested_correction: Include review and documentation of all migraine-related medications including NSAIDs or alternative therapies in medication reconciliation.

description: No documentation on possible cross-allergy with other beta-lactams or alternative analgesics given known penicillin and codeine allergies.
evidence_in_history: Penicillin and codeine allergies documented with reactions described.
evidence_in_summary: *No note on possible cross-allergy with other beta-lactams or alternative analgesics.*
suggested_correction: Document counseling or allergy assessment related to potential cross-reactivity with beta-lactams and alternative analgesics to avoid adverse reactions.

description: No instructions provided regarding hydration, lithium level monitoring, or recognition of lithium toxicity symptoms at discharge.
evidence_in_history: History includes lithium therapy with no mention of patient education on side effects or toxicity.
evidence_in_summary: No instructions provided regarding hydration, lithium level monitoring, or recognition of lithium toxicity symptoms.
suggested_correction: Provide clear discharge instructions on hydration importance, monitoring lithium levels, and signs/symptoms of toxicity.

description: No home health, social work, or nursing referrals documented despite patient fatigue and complex chronic conditions.
evidence_in_history: Patient reports fatigue and multiple chronic conditions; no mention of home support services.
evidence_in_summary: No home health, social work, or nursing service referrals documented.
suggested_correction: Assess need for and arrange appropriate home health or social support services for discharge planning.
